q: 我明天___医生见面。
zh: 我明天跟医生见面。
py: wǒ míng tiān gēn yī shēng jiàn miàn
en: I'm meeting the doctor tomorrow.
why: 见面 already holds its own object (面), so the other person goes before it with 跟 ('with'). 给 means 'for' and 对 means 'toward'; neither means 'meet with'.

q: 他感冒了，下周不能___上海出差了。
zh: 他感冒了，下周不能去上海出差了。
py: tā gǎn mào le xià zhōu bù néng qù shàng hǎi chū chāi le
en: He has a cold and can't go to Shanghai on business next week.
why: 出差 cannot be followed by the place, so the destination comes before it as 去上海出差. 从 would mean 'from Shanghai', and 把 and 给 do not introduce a destination.

q: 我昨天说错话了，今天应该___她道歉。
zh: 我昨天说错话了，今天应该向她道歉。
py: wǒ zuó tiān shuō cuò huà le jīn tiān yīng gāi xiàng tā dào qiàn
en: I said the wrong thing yesterday, so today I should apologise to her.
why: 道歉 has no slot for the person after it; the person you apologise to comes before the verb with 向. 让她道歉 would mean making her apologise, and 把 and 被 do not fit.

q: 医生进来以后，先___每位病人握了手。
zh: 医生进来以后，先跟每位病人握了手。
py: yī shēng jìn lái yǐ hòu xiān gēn měi wèi bìng rén wò le shǒu
en: After coming in, the doctor first shook hands with each patient.
why: 握手 cannot take the partner after it, so the partner goes before the verb with 跟 ('with'), and 了 sits inside the word. 给 means 'for' and 对 means 'toward', not 'with'.

q: 下雨天，我喜欢在家___朋友聊天。
zh: 下雨天，我喜欢在家跟朋友聊天。
py: xià yǔ tiān wǒ xǐ huan zài jiā gēn péng you liáo tiān
en: On rainy days I like to chat with friends at home.
why: 聊天 is verb + object, so 'with a friend' must come before it as 跟朋友. 对朋友聊天 would mean chatting at them, and 把 and 被 cannot be used here.

q: 小王还在生我___气吗？
zh: 小王还在生我的气吗？
py: xiǎo wáng hái zài shēng wǒ de qì ma
en: Is Xiao Wang still angry with me?
why: The person you are angry with sits inside 生气 as 我的: 生我的气. 得, 地 and 着 cannot link a pronoun to the noun 气.

q: 妈妈还在生___气，因为我忘了带伞。
zh: 妈妈还在生我的气，因为我忘了带伞。
py: mā ma hái zài shēng wǒ de qì yīn wèi wǒ wàng le dài sǎn
en: Mum is still angry with me because I forgot to take an umbrella.
why: 生气 leaves no room for a person after it, so 我 goes inside as 我的 (生我的气). 生气我气 repeats 气, and 的我 and 我得 are not possible.

q: 你能不能___我的忙？我手疼，拿不动箱子。
zh: 你能不能帮我的忙？我手疼，拿不动箱子。
py: nǐ néng bu néng bāng wǒ de máng wǒ shǒu téng ná bu dòng xiāng zi
en: Could you give me a hand? My hand hurts and I can't carry the box.
why: The person goes inside 帮忙 as 帮 + 我的 + 忙. 帮忙我的忙 or 帮助我的忙 would use the word twice, and 帮着我的忙 is not the pattern.

q: 医生今天特别忙，几个护士主动___他帮了很多忙。
zh: 医生今天特别忙，几个护士主动给他帮了很多忙。
py: yī shēng jīn tiān tè bié máng jǐ gè hù shi zhǔ dòng gěi tā bāng le hěn duō máng
en: The doctor was especially busy today, so several nurses volunteered to help him a lot.
why: 帮忙 takes no person after it, so the one helped goes before the verb with 给 ('for'). 对 means 'toward', and 把 and 被 build different sentence types.

q: 你为什么___我的气？
zh: 你为什么生我的气？
py: nǐ wèi shén me shēng wǒ de qì
en: Why are you angry with me?
why: 我的气 is already the object half of the word, so only 生 may come before it. 生气我的气 would use 气 twice.

q: 夏天太热了，我从来没在中午散___步。
zh: 夏天太热了，我从来没在中午散过步。
py: xià tiān tài rè le wǒ cóng lái méi zài zhōng wǔ sàn guo bù
en: It's so hot in summer that I've never gone for a walk at noon.
why: 从来没 asks for 过, which attaches to 散 and sits before 步: 散过步. 了 and 着 do not fit 从来没, and 得 needs a description after it.

q: 他昨晚一直说___话，我没睡好。
zh: 他昨晚一直说着话，我没睡好。
py: tā zuó wǎn yī zhí shuō zhe huà wǒ méi shuì hǎo
en: He kept talking last night and I didn't sleep well.
why: 一直 means the talking kept going, so 着 goes after 说: 说着话. 了 and 过 mark a finished act or an experience, and 完 would mean he stopped.

q: 明天下班后，我洗___澡就去找你。
zh: 明天下班后，我洗了澡就去找你。
py: míng tiān xià bān hòu wǒ xǐ le zǎo jiù qù zhǎo nǐ
en: Tomorrow after work I'll take a shower and then come and find you.
why: The first step is completed before the next clause, so 了 goes after 洗 and before 澡. 着 and 得 cannot mark a completed step, and 吗 is a question particle.

q: 他生病的时候从来没请___假，真厉害。
zh: 他生病的时候从来没请过假，真厉害。
py: tā shēng bìng de shí hou cóng lái méi qǐng guo jià zhēn lì hai
en: He never took leave even when he was ill, which is really impressive.
why: 没 + 过 says 'has never', and 过 sits after 请, before 假. 没请了假 cannot be said, and 着 and 完 do not express experience.

q: 夏天放___假，我们就去海边游泳。
zh: 夏天放了假，我们就去海边游泳。
py: xià tiān fàng le jià wǒ men jiù qù hǎi biān yóu yǒng
en: When the summer holiday starts, we'll go swimming at the seaside.
why: 了 after 放 marks the holiday as begun before the next clause follows. 放着假 would describe being on holiday, 放过假 an experience, and 得 needs a description.

q: 夜里太吵，我只睡___四个小时觉。
zh: 夜里太吵，我只睡了四个小时觉。
py: yè lǐ tài chǎo wǒ zhǐ shuì le sì gè xiǎo shí jiào
en: It was noisy at night and I only slept four hours.
why: 了 follows the verb 睡 and the duration 四个小时 comes before 觉: 睡了四个小时觉. 着, 得 and 的 do not mark a finished stretch of sleep.

q: 下雪天，我们在家聊___一个下午的天。
zh: 下雪天，我们在家聊了一个下午的天。
py: xià xuě tiān wǒ men zài jiā liáo le yī gè xià wǔ de tiān
en: On the snowy day we chatted at home for a whole afternoon.
why: A finished activity with a duration: 了 on 聊, then 一个下午的 before 天. 着 would make it ongoing, and 得 and 吗 cannot sit inside the word like this.

q: 他们___，孩子都上小学了。
zh: 他们结婚十年了，孩子都上小学了。
py: tā men jié hūn shí nián le hái zi dōu shàng xiǎo xué le
en: They've been married for ten years; their child is already in primary school.
why: 结婚 is a point event, so the time since goes after the whole word, then 了: 结婚十年了. 结了十年婚 treats it as an activity that lasts, which it is not.

q: 他们___，现在都过得很好。
zh: 他们离婚三年了，现在都过得很好。
py: tā men lí hūn sān nián le xiàn zài dōu guò de hěn hǎo
en: They've been divorced for three years and both are doing fine now.
why: 离婚 happens at one moment, so 'for three years' follows the whole word plus 了: 离婚三年了. Splitting the word (离了三年婚) is for lasting actions like 睡觉.

q: 他感冒了，请___三天假。
zh: 他感冒了，请了三天假。
py: tā gǎn mào le qǐng le sān tiān jià
en: He has a cold and took three days off.
why: 了 goes right after 请 and the length 三天 sits before 假: 请了三天假. 着 and 得 do not mark a completed period of leave, and 吗 cannot appear inside a statement.

q: 今天天气热，他游泳游___一个小时。
zh: 今天天气热，他游泳游了一个小时。
py: jīn tiān tiān qì rè tā yóu yǒng yóu le yī gè xiǎo shí
en: It's hot today, and he swam for an hour.
why: With the verb repeated, 了 follows the second 游 and the duration comes after it: 游泳游了一个小时. 着 and 得 do not mark a finished hour, and 吗 is a question particle.

q: 天气太热了，我想先洗___澡。
zh: 天气太热了，我想先洗个澡。
py: tiān qì tài rè le wǒ xiǎng xiān xǐ gè zǎo
en: It's too hot, I'd like to take a shower first.
why: 个 goes between 洗 and 澡 and makes the shower sound casual: 洗个澡. 次 would need a number to count showers, and 本 and 些 do not suit 澡.

q: 我们只见过两___面，还不太熟。
zh: 我们只见过两次面，还不太熟。
py: wǒ men zhǐ jiàn guo liǎng cì miàn hái bù tài shú
en: We've only met twice and aren't very close yet.
why: The number of meetings is counted with 次 inside the word: 见过两次面. 两个面 does not count occasions, and 些 and 本 are not measure words for it.

q: 你能___我一个忙吗？我的手受伤了。
zh: 你能帮我一个忙吗？我的手受伤了。
py: nǐ néng bāng wǒ yī gè máng ma wǒ de shǒu shòu shāng le
en: Can you do me a favour? My hand is hurt.
why: The pattern is plain 帮 + person + 一个忙. 帮忙 or 帮助 before 我一个忙 would use the word twice, and 帮着 is not used for asking a favour.

q: 他___，不想再结了。
zh: 他结过两次婚，不想再结了。
py: tā jié guo liǎng cì hūn bù xiǎng zài jié le
en: He has been married twice and doesn't want to marry again.
why: 过 and the count 两次 both go inside the word: 结 + 过 + 两次 + 婚. The other forms put 过 or 两次 around the whole word or break 结婚 in the wrong place.

q: 天气预报说明天有大雨，公司明天要开___会，讨论大家怎么来上班。
zh: 天气预报说明天有大雨，公司明天要开个会，讨论大家怎么来上班。
py: tiān qì yù bào shuō míng tiān yǒu dà yǔ gōng sī míng tiān yào kāi gè huì tǎo lùn dà jiā zěn me lái shàng bān
en: The forecast says heavy rain tomorrow, so the company will hold a meeting to discuss how everyone gets to work.
why: 开个会 is the casual 'hold a meeting', with 个 inside the word. 次 needs a number before it, and 些 and 本 are not measure words for 会.

q: 春天来了，我们出去___吧。
zh: 春天来了，我们出去散散步吧。
py: chūn tiān lái le wǒ men chū qù sàn sàn bù ba
en: Spring is here, let's go out for a little walk.
why: Only the verb half doubles: 散散步. The other options double or shift the object 步 or the wrong part of the word.

q: 下雨天没事做，来我家___吧。
zh: 下雨天没事做，来我家聊聊天吧。
py: xià yǔ tiān méi shì zuò lái wǒ jiā liáo liáo tiān ba
en: Nothing to do on a rainy day, so come over to my place for a chat.
why: 'A bit of a chat' doubles only the verb 聊: 聊聊天. The other forms repeat or move 天, which is the object and cannot double.

q: 昨天雪很大，我们在家聊___聊天，喝了热茶。
zh: 昨天雪很大，我们在家聊了聊天，喝了热茶。
py: zuó tiān xuě hěn dà wǒ men zài jiā liáo le liáo tiān hē le rè chá
en: It snowed heavily yesterday; we chatted at home and drank hot tea.
why: A finished 'little chat' puts 了 between the doubled verb: 聊了聊天. 着 and 过 do not fit this single finished event, and 得 needs a description.

q: 冬天外面太冷，你就在家___，不用出去了。
zh: 冬天外面太冷，你就在家唱唱歌，不用出去了。
py: dōng tiān wài miàn tài lěng nǐ jiù zài jiā chàng chàng gē bù yòng chū qù le
en: It's too cold outside; just sing a little at home and don't go out.
why: Doubling for 'a little' applies only to the verb 唱: 唱唱歌. 歌 is the object and never doubles, so the other forms are not Chinese.

q: 他说话___很慢。
zh: 他说话说得很慢。
py: tā shuō huà shuō de hěn màn
en: He speaks very slowly.
why: 得 must follow a verb, so 说 is repeated after 话: 说话说得很慢. In the other options 得, 了 and 的 would attach straight to the noun 话.

q: 冬天我睡觉___很早，晚上九点就睡了。
zh: 冬天我睡觉睡得很早，晚上九点就睡了。
py: dōng tiān wǒ shuì jiào shuì de hěn zǎo wǎn shang jiǔ diǎn jiù shuì le
en: In winter I go to bed very early, at nine in the evening.
why: 得 has to touch a verb, so 睡 is repeated: 睡觉睡得很早. 睡觉得 attaches 得 to the noun 觉, and 睡的 and 睡了 do not form a description.

q: 她跳舞跳___非常好，不像生过病的人。
zh: 她跳舞跳得非常好，不像生过病的人。
py: tā tiào wǔ tiào de fēi cháng hǎo bù xiàng shēng guo bìng de rén
en: She dances extremely well, not like someone who has been ill.
why: After the repeated verb 跳, the description is introduced by 得: 跳舞跳得非常好. 的 and 地 have other jobs, and 了 would only say the dancing finished.

q: 路上有雪，所以她今天___不太快。
zh: 路上有雪，所以她今天跑步跑得不太快。
py: lù shang yǒu xuě suǒ yǐ tā jīn tiān pǎo bù pǎo de bù tài kuài
en: There's snow on the road, so she isn't running very fast today.
why: The verb repeats after the object so that 得 touches a verb: 跑步跑得不太快. 跑步得 and 跑步的 leave 得/的 on the noun, and 跑得步 splits the word.

q: 他的歌___特别好，连医生都夸他。
zh: 他的歌唱得特别好，连医生都夸他。
py: tā de gē chàng de tè bié hǎo lián yī shēng dōu kuā tā
en: He sings especially well; even the doctor praised him.
why: With 歌 fronted as the topic, the verb appears once and 得 follows it: 歌唱得特别好. 唱歌得 repeats the object, and 着 and 了 do not link a description.

q: 你生___气？我又没说错话。
zh: 你生什么气？我又没说错话。
py: nǐ shēng shén me qì wǒ yòu méi shuō cuò huà
en: What are you angry about? I didn't say anything wrong.
why: 什么 goes inside the word between 生 and 气: 生什么气. 为什么 would give 'why' in the wrong slot, and 生谁气 and 什么的 are not used.

q: 昨晚太热了，我一直睡不___觉。
zh: 昨晚太热了，我一直睡不着觉。
py: zuó wǎn tài rè le wǒ yī zhí shuì bu zháo jiào
en: It was so hot last night that I couldn't fall asleep.
why: The potential form 睡不着 sits on the verb half, before 觉: 睡不着觉. 到, 完 and 起 do not make 'can't fall asleep'.

q: 昨天雨很大，我上___课就回家了。
zh: 昨天雨很大，我上完课就回家了。
py: zuó tiān yǔ hěn dà wǒ shàng wán kè jiù huí jiā le
en: It rained hard yesterday, and I went home as soon as class was over.
why: The result word 完 goes after the verb 上, before 课: 上完课就... 过 would mean 'have attended', and 着 and 得 do not give a result.

q: 我感冒了，已经三天没睡___觉了。
zh: 我感冒了，已经三天没睡好觉了。
py: wǒ gǎn mào le yǐ jīng sān tiān méi shuì hǎo jiào le
en: I have a cold and haven't slept properly for three days.
why: 好 is the result word and goes after 睡 before 觉: 没睡好觉. 完 would mean not finished sleeping, and 得 and 给 do not fit.

q: 外面下大雨，你___饭再走吧。
zh: 外面下大雨，你吃完饭再走吧。
py: wài miàn xià dà yǔ nǐ chī wán fàn zài zǒu ba
en: It's pouring outside; finish your meal before you leave.
why: The result word attaches to the verb: 吃完饭, built like 看完书. 吃着饭 means 'while eating', and 吃得饭 and a bare 的 are not Chinese.

zh: 我不想跟朋友见面。
py: wǒ bù xiǎng gēn péng you jiàn miàn
en: I don't want to meet up with my friends.
why: The friend comes before the verb with 跟; 见面 cannot be followed by 朋友 because 面 already fills the object slot.

zh: 我从来没在冬天游过泳。
py: wǒ cóng lái méi zài dōng tiān yóu guo yǒng
en: I have never gone swimming in winter.
why: 过 attaches to 游 and 泳 follows it: 游过泳. Putting 过 after the whole word (游泳过) is the tempting wrong order.

zh: 我今天睡了一下午觉。
py: wǒ jīn tiān shuì le yī xià wǔ jiào
en: I slept all afternoon today.
why: The duration sits between 睡了 and 觉. 睡觉了一下午 puts 了 and the time after the unsplit word, which is wrong.

zh: 冬天他喜欢洗个热水澡。
py: dōng tiān tā xǐ huan xǐ gè rè shuǐ zǎo
en: In winter he likes to take a hot bath.
why: 个 goes between the verb 洗 and the bath 热水澡 to make it casual; it cannot follow the object.

zh: 他游泳游得很快。
py: tā yóu yǒng yóu de hěn kuài
en: He swims very fast.
why: 得 must follow a verb, so 游 repeats after 游泳: 游泳游得很快. 游泳得很快 is the typical error.

zh: 因为感冒他唱歌唱得不太好。
py: yīn wèi gǎn mào tā chàng gē chàng de bù tài hǎo
en: Because he has a cold, he isn't singing very well.
why: Verb + object + repeated verb + 得 + description, with the negation in the description (不太好), not before 唱.

zh: 吃完饭我们去散散步。
py: chī wán fàn wǒ men qù sàn sàn bù
en: After dinner we'll go for a little walk.
why: Only the first half doubles: 散散 then 步. 散步散步 treats the word like 休息, but 步 is an object.

zh: 我吃完饭就去医院。
py: wǒ chī wán fàn jiù qù yī yuàn
en: I'll go to the hospital as soon as I've eaten.
why: The result word 完 goes right after 吃, before 饭: 吃完饭. 吃饭完 is wrong.

zh: 医生帮了我的大忙。
py: yī shēng bāng le wǒ de dà máng
en: The doctor was a great help to me.
why: The person goes inside 帮忙 as 我的: 帮了我的大忙. 帮忙我 cannot be built from these tiles, since the person must sit between the halves.

zh: 爸爸生我的气了。
py: bà ba shēng wǒ de qì le
en: Dad got angry with me.
why: The person inside 生气 is 我的: 生我的气, and 了 closes the sentence. 生气我 is wrong.

zh: 他们结婚已经十年了。
py: tā men jié hūn yǐ jīng shí nián le
en: They've already been married for ten years.
why: 结婚 is a point event, so the time since follows the whole word and 了 ends the sentence. 结了十年婚 would be wrong.

zh: 孩子们在雪地里唱着歌。
py: hái zi men zài xuě dì lǐ chàng zhe gē
en: The children are singing in the snow.
why: 着 attaches to the verb 唱, before 歌: 唱着歌. 唱歌着 puts it after the whole word.

zh: 医生明天要开个会。
py: yī shēng míng tiān yào kāi gè huì
en: The doctor is going to hold a meeting tomorrow.
why: 个 sits between 开 and 会 and makes the meeting casual: 开个会. 开会个 is not possible.

zh: 爸爸今年已经出过三次差。
py: bà ba jīn nián yǐ jīng chū guo sān cì chāi
en: Dad has already been on three business trips this year.
why: 过 and the count 三次 go inside 出差: 出 + 过 + 三次 + 差. 出差过三次 is the tempting wrong order.

zh: 他每天游半个小时的泳。
py: tā měi tiān yóu bàn gè xiǎo shí de yǒng
en: He swims for half an hour every day.
why: The duration plus 的 goes between 游 and 泳. After the whole word (游泳半个小时) it needs the verb repeated.

zh: 他应该向奶奶道歉。
py: tā yīng gāi xiàng nǎi nai dào qiàn
en: He should apologise to his grandmother.
why: 道歉 takes no person after it, so 向奶奶 comes before the verb. 道歉奶奶 is the English-style error.

zh: 我哥哥今年夏天大学毕业。
py: wǒ gē ge jīn nián xià tiān dà xué bì yè
en: My older brother graduates from university this summer.
why: The school goes before 毕业, never after it: 大学毕业, not 毕业大学. 毕业 has no slot for another object.

zh: 他昨晚没睡好觉。
py: tā zuó wǎn méi shuì hǎo jiào
en: He didn't sleep well last night.
why: The result word 好 attaches to 睡, before 觉: 没睡好觉. 睡觉好 cannot take the result.

zh: 我昨天睡觉睡得很晚。
py: wǒ zuó tiān shuì jiào shuì de hěn wǎn
en: I went to bed very late yesterday.
why: The verb 睡 repeats so that 得 touches a verb: 睡觉睡得很晚. 睡觉得很晚 leaves 得 on the noun 觉.

zh: 有空来我家聊聊天。
py: yǒu kòng lái wǒ jiā liáo liáo tiān
en: Come and chat at my place when you have time.
why: Only the verb half doubles: 聊聊天. 聊天聊天 is the tempting analogy with 休息休息.

task: Make it a gentle suggestion: 'go have a wash' with 吧.
zh: 你去洗洗澡吧。
py: nǐ qù xǐ xǐ zǎo ba
en: Go and have a wash.
why: 'A bit of' doubles only the verb half: 洗洗澡. 洗澡洗澡 is wrong.

src_py: tā shuì jiào shuì le shí gè xiǎo shí
task: Put the duration inside the word instead of repeating the verb.
zh: 他睡了十个小时觉。
py: tā shuì le shí gè xiǎo shí jiào
en: He slept for ten hours.
why: 了 and the duration go after 睡 and before 觉. 睡觉了十个小时 is wrong.

src_py: tā de gē chàng de hěn hǎo
task: Put the object after the verb and repeat the verb.
zh: 他唱歌唱得很好。
py: tā chàng gē chàng de hěn hǎo
en: He sings very well.
why: The verb repeats after the object so 得 touches a verb: 唱歌唱得很好. 唱歌得很好 is the classic error.

zh: 我想洗个澡。
py: wǒ xiǎng xǐ gè zǎo
en: I'd like to take a shower.
why: 个 goes between 洗 and 澡: 洗个澡. 洗澡个 is not possible.

task: Say 'we have met before', using 过.
zh: 我们以前见过面。
py: wǒ men yǐ qián jiàn guo miàn
en: We have met before.
why: 过 attaches to 见 and 面 follows: 见过面. 见面过 is wrong.

src: 我们下了课，然后去跑步。
src_py: wǒ men xià le kè rán hòu qù pǎo bù
task: Join into one sentence with 完 and 就.
zh: 下完课我们就去跑步。
py: xià wán kè wǒ men jiù qù pǎo bù
en: As soon as class is over, we'll go running.
why: 完 attaches to 下 before 课: 下完课. 下课完 is wrong.

task: Say 'don't be angry with me any more'.
zh: 你别生我的气了。
py: nǐ bié shēng wǒ de qì le
en: Stop being angry with me.
why: The person goes inside 生气 as 我的: 生我的气. 生气我 is wrong.

src_py: tā men liǎng nián qián jié hūn
task: Say they have been married for two years.
zh: 他们结婚两年了。
py: tā men jié hūn liǎng nián le
en: They have been married for two years.
why: 结婚 is a point event, so the time goes after the whole word, then 了. 结了两年婚 is wrong.

src_py: tā zuó wǎn shuì jiào shuì de hěn hǎo
zh: 他昨晚睡觉睡得不好。
py: tā zuó wǎn shuì jiào shuì de bù hǎo
en: He didn't sleep well last night.
why: Negation goes into the description (睡得不好), not before 睡.

src_py: zuó tiān xià wǔ wǒ men liáo tiān
task: Say 'we had a little chat' (finished), with 了.
zh: 昨天下午我们聊了聊天。
py: zuó tiān xià wǔ wǒ men liáo le liáo tiān
en: We had a little chat yesterday afternoon.
why: A finished 'bit of' puts 了 between the doubled verb: 聊了聊天. 聊聊天了 is wrong.

s: 他想见面爷爷。
s_py: tā xiǎng jiàn miàn yé ye
zh: 他想跟爷爷见面。
py: tā xiǎng gēn yé ye jiàn miàn
en: He wants to meet his grandfather.
why: 见面 cannot be followed by the person; 面 already fills the object slot. The person goes before: 跟爷爷见面.

s: 我哥哥结婚了一个医生。
s_py: wǒ gē ge jié hūn le yī gè yī shēng
zh: 我哥哥跟一个医生结婚了。
py: wǒ gē ge gēn yī gè yī shēng jié hūn le
en: My older brother married a doctor.
why: English 'marry someone' has an object, but 结婚 does not: the partner comes before as 跟一个医生结婚.

s: 弟弟打破了杯子，妈妈生气他了。
s_py: dì di dǎ pò le bēi zi mā ma shēng qì tā le
zh: 弟弟打破了杯子，妈妈生他的气了。
py: dì di dǎ pò le bēi zi mā ma shēng tā de qì le
en: Little brother broke a cup and Mum got angry with him.
why: The person you are angry with goes inside 生气 as 他的: 生他的气. 生气他 puts it after the word.

s: 谢谢你帮忙我。
s_py: xiè xie nǐ bāng máng wǒ
zh: 谢谢你帮我的忙。
py: xiè xie nǐ bāng wǒ de máng
en: Thank you for helping me.
why: 帮忙 cannot take 我 after it. The person goes inside as 帮我的忙, or use plain 帮我.

s: 我们没见面过。
s_py: wǒ men méi jiàn miàn guo
zh: 我们没见过面。
py: wǒ men méi jiàn guo miàn
en: We haven't met.
why: 过 attaches to the verb half 见, not to the whole word: 没见过面, like 没吃过饭.

s: 昨晚我睡觉了八个小时。
s_py: zuó wǎn wǒ shuì jiào le bā gè xiǎo shí
zh: 昨晚我睡了八个小时觉。
py: zuó wǎn wǒ shuì le bā gè xiǎo shí jiào
en: I slept for eight hours last night.
why: 了 and the duration go between the halves: 睡了八个小时觉. They cannot follow the whole word 睡觉.

s: 我毕了两年业。
s_py: wǒ bì le liǎng nián yè
zh: 我毕业两年了。
py: wǒ bì yè liǎng nián le
en: It's been two years since I graduated.
why: 毕业 happens at one moment, so time since goes after the whole word with 了: 毕业两年了. The word is not split.

s: 天气热，我想洗澡一个。
s_py: tiān qì rè wǒ xiǎng xǐ zǎo yī gè
zh: 天气热，我想洗个澡。
py: tiān qì rè wǒ xiǎng xǐ gè zǎo
en: It's hot; I'd like a quick shower.
why: 个 goes between 洗 and 澡, not after the whole word. 洗澡一个 is wrong.

s: 晚饭后，爷爷喜欢出去散步散步。
s_py: wǎn fàn hòu yé ye xǐ huan chū qù sàn bù sàn bù
zh: 晚饭后，爷爷喜欢出去散散步。
py: wǎn fàn hòu yé ye xǐ huan chū qù sàn sàn bù
en: After supper Grandpa likes to go out for a little walk.
why: Only the verb half doubles: 散散步. 步 is an object, so doubling the whole word, as with 休息休息, is wrong.

s: 弟弟跳舞得很好。
s_py: dì di tiào wǔ de hěn hǎo
zh: 弟弟跳舞跳得很好。
py: dì di tiào wǔ tiào de hěn hǎo
en: My little brother dances very well.
why: 得 must come right after a verb, so 跳 repeats: 跳舞跳得很好. 舞得 attaches 得 to a noun.

s: 她跑步得很慢，因为脚疼。
s_py: tā pǎo bù de hěn màn yīn wèi jiǎo téng
zh: 她跑步跑得很慢，因为脚疼。
py: tā pǎo bù pǎo de hěn màn yīn wèi jiǎo téng
en: She runs very slowly because her foot hurts.
why: 得 needs a verb before it, so 跑 repeats after 步: 跑步跑得很慢. 跑步得 leaves 得 on the noun.

s: 我洗澡完就睡觉。
s_py: wǒ xǐ zǎo wán jiù shuì jiào
zh: 我洗完澡就睡觉。
py: wǒ xǐ wán zǎo jiù shuì jiào
en: I'll go to sleep as soon as I've had my shower.
why: The result word 完 attaches to 洗, before 澡: 洗完澡. 洗澡完 is wrong, like 吃饭完.

s: 天气这么好，你生气什么呢？
s_py: tiān qì zhè me hǎo nǐ shēng qì shén me ne
zh: 天气这么好，你生什么气呢？
py: tiān qì zhè me hǎo nǐ shēng shén me qì ne
en: The weather's so nice; what are you angry about?
why: 什么 goes inside the word: 生什么气. 生气什么 puts it after the whole word.

s: 窗外下着大雨，我睡觉不着。
s_py: chuāng wài xià zhe dà yǔ wǒ shuì jiào bù zháo
zh: 窗外下着大雨，我睡不着觉。
py: chuāng wài xià zhe dà yǔ wǒ shuì bu zháo jiào
en: Heavy rain is falling outside the window and I can't get to sleep.
why: The potential form 不着 goes on the verb half: 睡不着觉. 睡觉不着 is wrong.

s: 他毕业了大学。
s_py: tā bì yè le dà xué
zh: 他大学毕业了。
py: tā dà xué bì yè le
en: He has graduated from university.
why: 毕业 takes no object after it. The school goes before the verb: 大学毕业.

s: 爸爸下周出差北京。
s_py: bà ba xià zhōu chū chāi běi jīng
zh: 爸爸下周去北京出差。
py: bà ba xià zhōu qù běi jīng chū chāi
en: Dad is going to Beijing on business next week.
why: 出差 cannot be followed by the place, which must come before as 去北京出差.

s: 他们说话着，老师就进来了。
s_py: tā men shuō huà zhe lǎo shī jiù jìn lái le
zh: 他们说着话，老师就进来了。
py: tā men shuō zhe huà lǎo shī jiù jìn lái le
en: They were talking when the teacher walked in.
why: 着 attaches to the verb half 说, not to the whole word: 说着话.

s: 因为我感冒了还去游泳，妈妈生气我了。
s_py: yīn wèi wǒ gǎn mào le hái qù yóu yǒng mā ma shēng qì wǒ le
zh: 因为我感冒了还去游泳，妈妈生我的气了。
py: yīn wèi wǒ gǎn mào le hái qù yóu yǒng mā ma shēng wǒ de qì le
en: Mum got angry with me because I went swimming while I had a cold.
why: 生气 takes no person after it. The person goes inside as 我的: 生我的气.

s: 你别担心他，他只是感冒了。
s_py: nǐ bié dān xīn tā tā zhǐ shì gǎn mào le
zh: 你别担心他，他只是感冒了。
py: nǐ bié dān xīn tā tā zhǐ shì gǎn mào le
en: Don't worry about him; he just has a cold.
why: 担心 is the exception: it is a normal verb that takes an object, so 担心他 is correct, unlike 见面他.

s: 我们放假了，可以去海边游泳了。
s_py: wǒ men fàng jià le kě yǐ qù hǎi biān yóu yǒng le
zh: 我们放假了，可以去海边游泳了。
py: wǒ men fàng jià le kě yǐ qù hǎi biān yóu yǒng le
en: We're on holiday, so we can go swimming at the seaside now.
why: Sentence-final 了 after the whole word (放假了) is correct; 了 only needs to go inside when the sentence continues after the verb or a number follows.

s: 下雨了，你能帮我一个忙吗？
s_py: xià yǔ le nǐ néng bāng wǒ yī gè máng ma
zh: 下雨了，你能帮我一个忙吗？
py: xià yǔ le nǐ néng bāng wǒ yī gè máng ma
en: It's raining; can you do me a favour?
why: Plain 帮 takes the person, then 一个忙 follows. This is correct; only 帮忙我 would be wrong.

s: 我们放了三天假，天天下雨。
s_py: wǒ men fàng le sān tiān jià tiān tiān xià yǔ
zh: 我们放了三天假，天天下雨。
py: wǒ men fàng le sān tiān jià tiān tiān xià yǔ
en: We had three days of holiday, and it rained every day.
why: 放假 can take a duration inside when the holiday itself lasted three days: 放了三天假. This is correct, unlike 结了十年婚.

s: 夏天她每天跑步跑四十分钟。
s_py: xià tiān tā měi tiān pǎo bù pǎo sì shí fēn zhōng
zh: 夏天她每天跑步跑四十分钟。
py: xià tiān tā měi tiān pǎo bù pǎo sì shí fēn zhōng
en: In summer she runs for forty minutes every day.
why: Repeating the verb with a duration is a correct way to give length: 跑步跑四十分钟, with no 了 needed for a habit.

s: 天气好的时候，我们喜欢在院子里跳跳舞。
s_py: tiān qì hǎo de shí hou wǒ men xǐ huan zài yuàn zi lǐ tiào tiào wǔ
zh: 天气好的时候，我们喜欢在院子里跳跳舞。
py: tiān qì hǎo de shí hou wǒ men xǐ huan zài yuàn zi lǐ tiào tiào wǔ
en: When the weather is nice, we like to dance a little in the yard.
why: Only the verb half doubles, so 跳跳舞 is right; the temptation is to think it must be 跳舞跳舞.

s: 她的舞跳得非常好，连医生都说她很健康。
s_py: tā de wǔ tiào de fēi cháng hǎo lián yī shēng dōu shuō tā hěn jiàn kāng
zh: 她的舞跳得非常好，连医生都说她很健康。
py: tā de wǔ tiào de fēi cháng hǎo lián yī shēng dōu shuō tā hěn jiàn kāng
en: She dances extremely well; even the doctor says she's very healthy.
why: Object-first is a valid way to avoid repeating the verb: 舞跳得非常好. 得 directly follows the verb 跳.

s: 他洗完澡就觉得舒服多了。
s_py: tā xǐ wán zǎo jiù jué de shū fu duō le
zh: 他洗完澡就觉得舒服多了。
py: tā xǐ wán zǎo jiù jué de shū fu duō le
en: He felt much better as soon as he'd had a shower.
why: The result word 完 goes after 洗, before 澡: 洗完澡. Correct, built like 吃完饭.

s: 他们以前吵过架，现在是好朋友。
s_py: tā men yǐ qián chǎo guo jià xiàn zài shì hǎo péng you
zh: 他们以前吵过架，现在是好朋友。
py: tā men yǐ qián chǎo guo jià xiàn zài shì hǎo péng you
en: They used to quarrel, but now they're good friends.
why: 过 attaches to the verb half 吵, before 架: 吵过架. It looks odd to English speakers but is exactly the standard pattern.

s: 她今天头疼，睡了一上午觉。
s_py: tā jīn tiān tóu téng shuì le yī shàng wǔ jiào
zh: 她今天头疼，睡了一上午觉。
py: tā jīn tiān tóu téng shuì le yī shàng wǔ jiào
en: Her head hurt today and she slept the whole morning.
why: The duration (一上午) sits between 睡了 and 觉. This is the correct form; 睡觉了一上午 would be wrong.

s: 夏天晚上，大家都喜欢和邻居聊天。
s_py: xià tiān wǎn shang dà jiā dōu xǐ huan hé lín jū liáo tiān
zh: 夏天晚上，大家都喜欢和邻居聊天。
py: xià tiān wǎn shang dà jiā dōu xǐ huan hé lín jū liáo tiān
en: On summer evenings everyone likes chatting with the neighbours.
why: The partner comes before 聊天 with 和, exactly as it should. It is correct, not a misplaced object.

s: 天气一冷，我洗了澡就上床睡觉了。
s_py: tiān qì yī lěng wǒ xǐ le zǎo jiù shàng chuáng shuì jiào le
zh: 天气一冷，我洗了澡就上床睡觉了。
py: tiān qì yī lěng wǒ xǐ le zǎo jiù shàng chuáng shuì jiào le
en: Once the weather turns cold, I take a shower and go straight to bed.
why: Verb 了 goes inside (洗了澡) because the sentence continues with 就. The final 了 after 睡觉 is a separate sentence-final 了, so both are correct.
